messages:
jon_newhire: Hi all, quick onboarding questions from week 1 — sorry for the rapid-fire. 1) When does medical/dental start if I began on 2026-04-11? 2) Are company holidays pro-rated if you start mid-year? 3) I bought a chair for $95  can I expense it and how? 4) Will my first paycheck show a prorated PTO balance or do I need to request it?

sophie (People Ops): Welcome, Jon! :tada: Short answers: medical/dental = first of the month after 30 days (so in your case 2026-06-01 unless you selected expedited during enrollment). Company holidays are not "pro-rated" but floating holidays/PTO are prorated based on hire date. Chair reimbursement: use Ramp "Onboarding - Home Office" or our expense form if you don't yet have Ramp. PTO balance shows in Rippling within one pay cycle; if it doesn't, DM me.

jon_newhire: thanks. How strict is the 14-day benefits enrollment window? I missed the email for the initial 14 days and only saw the Rippling invite a bit late.

sophie (People Ops): If you missed the 14-day window we still try to allow retro enrollments in Rippling; ping benefits@redwood.com and include your start date. We can sometimes process a manual enrollment without defaulting you to the base plan, but it depends on carrier deadlines.

mike_payroll: Payroll note: we run semi-monthly (15th & last day). Since Jon started 4/11, payroll on 4/30 will include prorated earnings 4/11-4/30. Reimbursements approved after the payroll cutoff go on the next run. If you need faster reimbursement (+instant), route through Ramp and tag @mike_payroll in the comment with "urgent-offcycle".

jon_newhire: chair receipt attached. I don't have Ramp yet. Is the Google form still okay?

sophie (People Ops): Yes, use the Google expense form and cc finance@redwood.com. Example note: 

```
Expense: Ergonomic chair
Amount: $95.00
Date: 2026-04-12
Category: Onboarding - Home Office
Notes: One-time new hire remote workspace
```

jon_newhire: perfect. about PTO: which calendar shows the company observed holidays? I want to block time for the summer off-days.

sophie (People Ops): The company holiday calendar is on the handbook page (https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/time-off) and we push an official Google calendar invite to all employees after payroll sync. If you don't see it, DM me and I'll share the calendar link.

hr-bot: Automated reminder: New hire benefits enrollment due by 2026-04-25. Complete elections in Rippling to avoid default plan assignment.

jon_newhire: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll submit the expense form now and follow up with benefits@redwood. Appreciate the quick answers!
